DNSquachWatch v1.8.3 — ST7789-80MHz, based on SquachWatch v1.35.0.

SD writes now require an accepted data response and programming completion. Multi-sector writes wait after the stop token; CMD13 consumes its complete status response. Test Card reports precise write/read-back/cleanup results on screen and serial. The separate display/card controllers and software resistive touch from v1.8.2 remain, along with DNSP features.

DNSP reports successful Test Card, backup, Safe Shutdown and reset/remount on the tested device/card, with touch appearing normal. This is scoped confirmation, not universal card compatibility or endurance validation. Compilation, native regressions, adapter tests and image/package checks passed.

Image: 1,949,728 bytes, with 16,352 bytes free in the existing slot. Keep DNSP Content/v1.5 unchanged. No routine ESP32 erase or card format is needed. The kit includes all four flashing binaries. Serial is 115200 baud.
